chunks: And in the book of ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah, it is reported that al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام said:
“The minimum that suffices in the case of close combat is two takbīrs for every salat, except al-Maghrib, for it has three takbīrs.”

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the utterance of 'Allāhu Akbar' in the prayer context
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبَ: the Maghrib prayer, treated here as an exception
key_terms.الْمُسَايَفَةِ: close combat or sword-fighting conditions affecting the performance of salat
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَتَانِ: two takbīrs as the minimum sufficient amount

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number of takbirs required for salat during close combat according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for salat in a state of close combat, specifying the minimum number of takbirs that suffice. It distinguishes al-Maghrib from the other prayers by requiring three takbirs for it, while two suffice for each other salat.
